checks.message: Maintainer provisional boundary is explicitly marked; no official-redline claim is made.
All three required key areas are present and explicitly provisional.
Conceptual land-use polygons derive from a sequential difference partition of the submitted site.
Known spatial metrics are calculated in EPSG:4548 from submitted geometry; statutory controls remain unknown.
Static bilingual HTML uses only local assets and contains no scripts, remote resources, forms, API calls or tracking.
Chinese and English narrative, HTML, figures and PDFs use mapped localized filenames.
Each AI scenario specifies minimum data, human review, non-digital fallback and stop or opt-out conditions.
Narrative claims reference sources, standards, depth items, geometry and metrics without dense marker dumps.
All figures are generated from repository geometry and original vector drawing code; fonts and tools are recorded.
